items.title: Today's PHP Security Release, and How We're Strengthening PHP Security
items.summary: Today&x27;s PHP Security Release, and How We&x27;re Strengthening PHP Security If you're running anything on PHP it's vital you upgrade - today's updates (across the entire PHP 8.x line) address two remote code execution holes, and there have been exploits circulating since last night, thanks to a leak in the coordinated disclosure process. This post from the PHP Foundation explain what went so wrong: On Tuesday, October 20th, at around 15:00 UTC, the two CVE IDs began circulating on online forums and social media. They came with a wrong release time and a wrong CVSS score of 10.0 (the actual score is 9.2). No technical details leaked. In response, the PHP project brought its pre-announcement forward and published it at 19:30 UTC . It also moved the release from October 22nd, 14:00 UTC,…
items.so_what: La explicación de PHP Foundation sobre la liberación de parches y el proceso de divulgación coordinada de vulnerabilidades descubiertas por IA, subraya la importancia de la seguridad y el riesgo de filtraciones en la coordinación.
